name: Topaz Bloom (upscale)
description: Topaz Labs' creative upscalers (Bloom 2, Bloom, Bloom Realism) through fal.ai: adds detail, may change small things. Topaz can take several minutes on a large picture; the window stays usable while it runs. Written from the provider's schema and not run against the live API yet. Also on Oxen.ai.

fal.note: topaz/upscale/image/creative on fal: 1 to 4 times; Creativity (1 to 9) applies to Bloom 2 only. Upscale (the button next to Generate) runs it on the selection, which comes back sharper at the document's resolution, or on the whole picture, which becomes N times larger with every layer scaled along.

oxen.note: Runs on Oxen.ai (one key for many models); not run against the live API yet (written from Oxen's docs and model list, 2026-09-26). The pictures go inline (data URLs, which Oxen's docs allow but do not recommend for production) in the request to Oxen.ai, which runs the model or passes it on; Oxen keeps every generated image in your Oxen account, and its terms could not be read, so how long it keeps what you send is not stated. Bloom 2 on Oxen: its schema has no factor, so the model picks the size (not verified). The tab's prompt goes along as guidance (up to 1024 characters). Priced per Topaz credit ($0.08 a credit); how many credits an image takes is not stated.
